top_signals.title: Treasuries Higher for a Third Day as Oil Prices Slide
top_signals.summary: Benchmark US Treasuries rose for a third day with support from falling commodity prices prices and speculation that most of the Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest-rate hikes are already priced in.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
